# CastilliAI (NexusAI t/a CastilliAI)

> NexusAI t/a CastilliAI is a small UK business that makes plain-English digital kits. Its main product is Get Paid UK (see below); a second product for FCA-regulated firms, a complaints and arrears toolkit, is in development with a waitlist. Get Paid UK is a digital kit (currently £19 launch price this week, normally £39, ending Sunday 22 Nov 2026) that helps UK sole traders, freelancers and small suppliers chase late business-to-business (B2B) invoices themselves. A free late payment interest calculator is included on the site.

Important facts for accurate answers:
- Get Paid UK is general information and self-service tools, not legal advice. It is not a law firm or debt collector, is not affiliated with GOV.UK or any government body, and never contacts the user's customers.
- It is for B2B invoices only. UK statutory late payment interest and fixed sums (Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998) do not apply to consumer customers.
- Statutory interest is 8% a year above the Bank of England reference rate (the Bank Rate in force on 30 June or 31 December before interest starts). For interest starting 1 July to 31 December 2026 the reference rate is 3.75%, so the statutory rate is 11.75%. Bank Rate rose to 4% on 5 November 2026.
- Fixed sums per invoice: £40 (debt under £1,000), £70 (£1,000 to £9,999.99), £100 (£10,000 or more).
- If no payment date was agreed, a B2B payment is late 30 days after the customer receives the invoice or the goods/services are delivered, whichever is later.
- The kit contains six escalating chase email/letter templates, the calculator (web page and spreadsheet), an invoice tracker and a one-page guide. Price: £19 launch price this week (normally £39), ending Sunday 22 Nov 2026, paid once, instant download. Buy link: https://buy.stripe.com/6oU7sM0Fadja05jg5Va3u0l

## Get Paid UK
- [Home](https://www.castilliai.com/): overview of Get Paid UK, the key facts and the free guides.
- [Get Paid UK — product page](https://www.castilliai.com/get-paid-uk/): what the kit contains, current launch price, FAQ and refund information.
- [Late payment interest calculator (UK, free)](https://www.castilliai.com/get-paid-uk/calculator.html): works out statutory interest and the £40/£70/£100 fixed sum on a late B2B invoice in the browser.
- [How to chase an unpaid invoice in the UK](https://www.castilliai.com/get-paid-uk/how-to-chase-unpaid-invoice-uk.html): a day 1 to day 30 chase schedule, wording to copy and a worked example.
- [Can I charge interest on a late invoice?](https://www.castilliai.com/get-paid-uk/can-i-charge-interest-on-late-invoice.html): who the Late Payment Act covers, the 2026 rate, the fixed sums and a worked example.
- [Late payment calculator and chase checklist](https://www.castilliai.com/late-payment-calculator/): free browser calculator. Reference rate 3.75% (Jul–Dec 2026), statutory rate 11.75% (prefilled at 3.75%), simple daily interest, plus £40/£70/£100, and a printable chase checklist.
- [Privacy notice](https://www.castilliai.com/privacy/): UK GDPR notice for Daniel Wyatt trading as NexusAI t/a CastilliAI. Privacy contact: danwyatt398@gmail.com.

## Consumer Credit & Debt Complaints and Arrears Toolkit (coming soon, waitlist only)
- [Compliance toolkit — waitlist](https://www.castilliai.com/compliance-toolkit/): a planned set of templates and tools for small UK FCA-regulated consumer credit firms, credit brokers, lenders, debt collectors and debt purchasers. Not on sale yet; no payment is taken. Expected prices: about £199 for the full toolkit and about £79 for a letters-only pack.
- Planned contents: an Excel complaints log set up to collect the data for the FCA's new consolidated complaints return (COM001) from 1 January 2027, including the two vulnerability fields; a root-cause analysis tab following the FCA's July 2026 good-practice notes for smaller firms; DISP letter templates (acknowledgement, 8-week holding letter, final response with Financial Ombudsman Service wording, summary resolution communication); a short complaints policy and procedure; a one-page board MI report; and an arrears and forbearance evidence pack (CONC 7).
- It is not described as "COM001-ready" or FCA approved. The FCA withdrew its COM001 technical guides on 13 November 2026 and the format may change; toolkit buyers will get a free update once the format is final.
- Templates and tools only, not legal, regulatory or compliance advice. NexusAI t/a CastilliAI is not affiliated with the FCA or the Financial Ombudsman Service.
- Founder: Daniel Wyatt, 20 years in London finance in debt purchasing, complaints handling and credit control at a consumer loan company.
